sections.title: A local presence with a broader perspective.
sections.body: LeSeft Nigeria is the local operating unit of the LeSeft Group, with an office in Abuja and an operational team on the ground. As a Trading House and Project Office, we connect commodity flows, equipment, technology and projects with opportunities in Nigeria and West Africa.
items: Abuja office and local operating team
Part of the wider LeSeft Group

sections.title: Connections made practical.
sections.body: Our approach combines the group's international trade experience and business connections with local implementation capabilities. We help partners identify opportunities and coordinate the steps required to move them forward.

sections.title: Closer to the opportunity.
sections.body: Our international network connects Europe and Asia with Nigeria and West Africa, bringing manufacturers, suppliers, buyers, investors and institutions closer to the right conversations.

pages.seoDescription: Explore LeSeft Nigeria's commodity activities across agriculture, food security, minerals and metals.

hero.heading:

with opportunity.
hero.subtitle: Supporting commodity enquiries and bringing buyers and suppliers together across markets.

sections.title: Moving essential resources forward.
sections.body: We work across agricultural commodities and related products, supporting connections between demand, supply and the people who depend on them.

sections.title: Opening pathways for mineral trade.
sections.body: We support enquiries relating to mineral and metal commodities, including positions sourced from West Africa where available and appropriate to the enquiry.
items: Other West African commodity positions, subject to specific enquiries

sections.title: Power for a changing future.
sections.body: We connect project requirements with equipment and technology through our international network. Export finance support may be available for eligible projects, subject to partner approval and terms.
items: Small, medium and large-scale thermal power plants
Export finance support for eligible projects

sections.title: Solutions for resources and industry.
sections.body: We support the identification of equipment and technologies suited to mining and primary mineral-processing projects, including potential export finance support for eligible projects.
items: Equipment and technology solutions for mining projects
Export finance support for eligible projects

sections.title: The essential components of progress.
sections.body: From individual components to water-treatment solutions, we help connect industrial requirements with suitable international suppliers and technologies.

sections.title: A considered path from concept to launch.
sections.body: We support states and private investors through project development and management, helping coordinate work from feasibility through implementation and launch.

sections.title: Building the foundations for reliable energy.
sections.body: We support the development of energy projects through feasibility, partner and technology selection and implementation coordination.

sections.title: Turning resource potential into opportunity.
sections.body: From early-stage study to sourcing and project support, we help bring mining and primary mineral-processing opportunities into focus.

sections.title: Thoughtful solutions for essential resources.

sections.title: A local partner for entering new markets.
sections.body: For international manufacturers and suppliers of equipment and technologies looking to enter Nigeria and West Africa, our local entity and team provide a point of connection and implementation support.

sections.title: A closer connection to West African supply.
sections.body: For international buyers, including those in Europe, Asia and the Americas, we support specific enquiries and help connect potential buyers with suppliers.

sections.title: International expertise for local ambitions.
sections.body: For Nigerian organisations, states and private investors seeking international business and project-development support, we help identify partners and coordinate opportunities.
items: Energy generation and water infrastructure projects

sections.title: Connecting markets and shared priorities.
sections.body: We support closer economic and trade relationships between Nigeria, West Africa and international markets, including Europe, Asia and the Americas.
